Description

*PLEASE NOTE THAT METAL STUDS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED ON THE PITCH*

A variety of sports can be played at the Warren Sports Pitch with the main one being 5-a-side football. The Warren Sports Pitch is one of the finest and best located sports facilities in Central London and it is the place to be if you’re looking for a 5-a-side football pitch, Tag Rugby or an outside exercise area to hire for Bootcamps, Circuit Training, Kid Parties and SAQs.

Five-a-side football remains one of the most popular activities played at Warren Sports Pitch and the staff keep the playing surface in excellent condition all year around, whatever the weather and temperature. It is possible to play throughout the winter months, whether you are part of a team, league or simply playing with friends. The Warren Sports Pitch benefits from high quality floodlights which means the facility is perfect for those who love to play sport after work.

Parking is available on the surrounding streets with parking meters close by. Those keen on driving to the facility should remember to bring change for the machines.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

For those who like the security of knowing you can play at the same time every week without fail, you can make advance bookings at Warren Sports Pitch dependent on availability.

The very accommodating team at Playfinder will help you to secure your preferred slot or if that isn’t available, we will help you to secure the best alternative.

The closest station when travelling is Warren Street. The facility is located a short walk from here - for more details on how to access the facility please contact the venue.
